Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:55409
Court No. - 12

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 6841 of 2024
Applicant :- Pankaj
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru.
Its Prin.Secy. Deptt. Of Home
Counsel for Applicant :- Ashish Mishra,Mohd. Imran Khan

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.

1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2.
The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.198 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Motipur, District Baharaich.
3. In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that the sister of the informant was married to the applicant in the year 2019 and sufficient dowry was given.
However, the entire matrimonial family used to harass her for dowry and subsequently, the informant was killed by the matrimonial family.
The cause of death as per the postmortem report, is ante mortem hanging and apart from the ligature Pankaj vs State Of U.P. Thru.

1 mark, no other injury is visible on the body of the deceased.
The applicant is the husband.
4. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

5. Considering the post mortem report and the fact that there is no specific statement against the applicant to suggest that soon before her death, the victim was subjected to any physical or mental harassment in relation to any demand of dowry coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal antecedents and is languishing in jail since 19.04.2024, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Pankaj be released on bail in the abovesaid first information report number on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 12.8.2024 akverma  Pankaj vs State Of U.P. Thru.
